title: Slice the duplicate scan so it stops holding the database writer
body: The duplicate scan used to run as one database callback that committed after each bucket but never gave up the single writer thread. Commit 014ffb6f4 (2026-08-02, "Fix dedup scan scheduling") split it into many small low-priority callbacks, so grid reads and other writes can run between buckets. A related change rewrites only the groups a bucket touched, where before every group was rewritten after every bucket.
